protocol: Unrestricted autoregressive K3. Ask for three successive visited rooms, separated by commas. Accept one complete line or EOS, verify each transition independently, reject capped outputs. No answer-conditioned retries.
sft: Only on adequate yield: compare own verified responses versus gold responses on the same first eight accepted map IDs, eight updates at batch four per arm, fresh AdamW, response-only CE. Evaluate both on the same 16 separate maps. Stop on safety, nonfinite or time budget.
scope: One bounded yield/SFT cycle, independent of categorical curriculum success.
